q: How are the Philippians called to work out their salvation?
a: The Philippians are to work out their salvation with fear and trembling.

q: For what purpose is Paul pouring out his life?
a: Paul is pouring out his life in the sacrifice and service of the Philippian’s faith.

q: What righteousness does Paul now have?
a: Paul now has the righteousness from God that is through faith in Christ.
